rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING INDEPENDENT HEALTH AND ENVIRONMENTAL ASSESSMENT FOR ALL MINING PROJECTS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE PHILIPPINE MINING ACT OF 1995
rows.abstract: The bill requires that an independent health and environmental assessment of the communities surrounding a mine site be conducted every 5 years from the start of mining operations until 10 years after its closure. An independent Assessment Fund shall be established for the purpose and deposited as a trust fund in a government depository bank.

rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTOMATICALLY ASSIGNING TO GOVERNMENT INSURANCE PROCEEDS OF CORPORATIONS UNDERTAKING INDUSTRIAL PROJECTS WHENEVER MAJOR ACCIDENT, DISASTER OR CATASTROPHIC EVENT OCCURS INVOLVING THEIR INDUSTRIAL PROJECT CAUSING DAMAGE TO PERSONS, PROPERTY, AND ENVIRONMENT
rows.title_short: \"Industrial Disaster Insurance Act of 2005\"
rows.abstract: \"Industrial Disaster Insurance Act of 2005\".  The bill provides for the automatic assignment to the government of the insurance proceeds paid to corporations should a catastrophic event or accident occur causing grave damage to persons, property or environment. In this manner, the government can be assured that compensation for the damage caused will be indemnified.

rows.title_short: \"Tuition Regulation Act of 2007\"
rows.abstract: \"Tuition Regulation Act of 2007\".  To broaden the campaign against unreasonable and unwarranted tuition fee increases every academic year, the bill seeks the creation of a Tuition Regulatory Council (TRC) that shall serve as the highest policy making body on matters concerning tuition fee rates, modification and other tuition related matters. The TRC shall study, conduct consultations and thereafter recommend adjustments in tuition and other school fees.

rows.title_short: \"Security of Tenure and Benefits of Day Care Workers Act\"
rows.abstract: \"Security of Tenure and Benefits of Day Care Workers Act\".  The bill proposes to give day care workers a minimum of five (5) years appointment and salaries and benefits commensurate to their competence level.

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE MANDATORY ALLOCATION OF FIVE PERCENT OF THE TOTAL BUDGET OF EVERY PROVINCES, MUNICIPALITIES, AND CITIES FOR THE HOUSING PROGRAM FOR THE URBAN POOR
rows.title_short: \"Housing Program Funds Allocation Act\"
rows.abstract: \"Housing Program Funds Allocation Act\".  The bills aims to ensure the implementation and sustainability of housing programs for the urban poor by allocating 5% of the total budget every province, municipality and city for this purpose.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT since 2007-08-08

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING ALL PROVINCES AND HIGHLY-URBANIZED CITIES TO ESTABLISH A TECHNICAL VOCATIONAL AND SKILLS TRAINING SCHOOLS
rows.title_short: \"Technical Vocational and Skills Training School Establishment Act\"
rows.abstract: \"Technical Vocational and Skills Training School Establishment Act\".  The bill mandates all provinces and cities to establish technical vocation and skills training schools to make quality technical vocation education accessible to out0of0school youth and the general public.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2007-08-08

rows.title_short: \"Civil Service Sub-Professional Eligibility for Non-Permanent Government Employees Act\"
rows.abstract: \"Civil Service Sub-Professional Eligibility for Non-Permanent Government Employees Act\".  The measure confers sub-professional civil service eligibility to non-permanent government employees who have rendered at least nine (9) years of service.
